description: Elevarq Signals chart values, validated by Helm on `helm install`/`helm template`. NOTE: this file is NOT the source of the Amazon EKS add-on configuration schema — AWS reads the dedicated `aws_mp_configuration_schema.json` at the chart top level for `describe-addon-configuration` (#297 disproved the earlier #285/#290 assumption that AWS derives it from values.schema.json). See marketplace-eks-addon-delivery.md (R-EAO-07). The top-level object stays open (no additionalProperties:false) because AWS add-on ingestion renders the chart with Helm's reserved `global` value injected, and a closed top level fails `helm template` -> INVALID_HELM_TEMPLATE (#290).

image.description: Container image. Pinned to the Marketplace-ECR artifact for the add-on; override only for private mirrors.

target.description: PostgreSQL target. Set host to enable collection; token/secret/mtls auth methods require sslmode verify-full.

host.description: PostgreSQL hostname (e.g. the RDS endpoint). Required to enable collection.

sslCertFile.description: mtls: filesystem PATH to the PEM client certificate (never its contents). Mount the cert via extraVolumes/extraVolumeMounts and point this at the mount path. Required for mtls.

sslKeyFile.description: mtls: filesystem PATH to the PEM client private key (never its contents). Mount the key via extraVolumes/extraVolumeMounts and point this at the mount path. Required for mtls.

sslKeyPassphraseFile.description: mtls: optional filesystem PATH to a file holding the passphrase for an encrypted client key (never the passphrase itself). Mount via extraVolumes/extraVolumeMounts.

targets.description: Additional PostgreSQL targets (#347). Each item is rendered into the mounted signals.yaml `targets:` list, in addition to the single `target` above, so one install can monitor several databases. `name` and `host` are required per item; token/secret/mtls auth methods require sslmode verify-full at runtime. Password auth uses passwordFile/passwordEnv (the managed passwordSecretName injection stays single-target).

name.description: Target identifier, unique within the install.

sslCertFile.description: mtls: filesystem PATH to the PEM client certificate (never its contents).

sslKeyFile.description: mtls: filesystem PATH to the PEM client private key (never its contents).

sslKeyPassphraseFile.description: mtls: optional filesystem PATH to the encrypted-key passphrase file (never the passphrase itself).

passwordFile.description: Password method: filesystem PATH to a mounted password file (never the password itself).

passwordEnv.description: Password method: name of an environment variable holding the password (supply it via extraEnv).

tokenSecretName.description: Kubernetes Secret holding the API bearer token; recommended for production so the token survives restarts.

env.description: Runtime environment. prod hard-fails on weak API tokens and requires verify-full for token auth.

annotations.description: Identity binding, e.g. eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn for IRSA (passwordless RDS IAM).

extraEnv.description: Additional non-secret environment variables. Secret values must use valueFrom. Chart-managed SIGNALS_* names are rejected at render.

extraVolumes.description: Extra pod volumes, e.g. a Secret/ConfigMap holding the verify-full CA bundle.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Mounts for extraVolumes, e.g. the CA bundle at target.sslRootCertFile.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for the collector's PersistentVolume. On EKS set an EBS-CSI class (e.g. an encrypted gp3).
